clarification_questions: Are the 1000 snapshots taken from a single continuous flow or run on shared hosts, or are they separately initiated flows each starting from a clean state? This determines whether they can be treated as distinct experimental units.

What is the time interval between consecutive snapshots, and is there any reason to believe each snapshot is causally isolated from the previous one (e.g., separate TCP connections, independent queue states)?
How many distinct run-level replications (separately initiated experiments, potentially on different occasions or host pairs) are available, separate from the 1000 within-run snapshots?
